description: This source file defines a Swift enum CritterIconRenderer responsible for creating and rendering an icon of a critter with customizable features such as size, facial expression, and badges. It contains nested structs for managing visual geometry and options, as well as methods to generate the icon NSImage with detailed drawing logic.

methods.name: makeIcon
methods.description: Generates an NSImage icon of a critter based on parameters like blink, leg wiggle, ear wiggle, scale, badges, and eyes state. It sets up the drawing context, creates the canvas, computes geometry, draws the body and face, adds badges if provided, and returns the final image.

methods.name: makeBitmapRep
methods.description: Creates a bitmap image representation with fixed pixel dimensions to ensure sharpness on Retina displays.

methods.name: makeCanvas
methods.description: Initializes drawing canvas parameters, including pixel stepping and snapping functions based on the image representation.

methods.name: drawBody
methods.description: Draws the critter's body shape, ears, and legs onto the canvas.

methods.name: drawFace
methods.description: Draws the critter's eyes, nose, and optional ear holes or closed eyes, based on provided options.

methods.name: drawBadge
methods.description: Draws a badge with an icon and prominence level at the top-right corner of the critter icon.
